description: The popover of a form field under the caret (redesign DE-1.6): a content control (date, drop-down, combo box, picture) or a signing field (label, required, signer role), on the shared floating frame. Title and kind in the header, meta chips with icons (kind, required, locked, repeats on every page) and tm-input editors that are all disabled when the content is locked. Every change applies at once (no OK); the footer holds a visible Close. It anchors to the field through the viewport rectangle the canvas engine reports.

parameters.name: AnchorRect
parameters.description: Viewport rectangle of the field (CSS pixels) the popover anchors to.

parameters.name: ContentControl
parameters.description: The content control to edit. Set exactly one of ContentControl and SigningField.

parameters.name: ImageAssets
parameters.description: The image assets a picture control can choose from.

parameters.name: OnChoiceChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen value of a drop-down or combo box.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the popover asks to close, with the reason: the X and the footer Close are Button, Escape is Escape, a press outside (or a canvas scroll) is Outside, the sheet's Done is Done. The host gives focus back to its canvas only for Button, Escape and Done.

parameters.name: OnComboTextChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the free text of a combo box.

parameters.name: OnDateChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new ISO date of a date control.

parameters.name: OnPictureChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen asset id of a picture control.

parameters.name: OnSigningLabelChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new label of a signing field.

parameters.name: OnSigningRequiredChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new required flag of a signing field.

parameters.name: OnSigningRoleChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the chosen signer role of a signing field.

parameters.name: SigningRoles
parameters.description: The signer roles of a signing field; the role select renders only when there is at least one.
